metadata.title: Realistic Multi-Project Workload & Contention Estimation Model
metadata.description: Empirical context-switching & schedule slippage rules for multi-project resource contention in banking IT PMO.
references: Gerald Weinberg, Quality Software Management: Systems Thinking (1991)
Clark & Wheelwright, Revolutionizing Product Development (Harvard Business Review)
Tom DeMarco & Timothy Lister, Peopleware: Productive Projects and Teams

rules.description: 100% capacity dedicated to project. Zero context-switching loss.
40% real capacity per project. 20% lost to mental context-switching.
High contention: only ~20% capacity per project. 40% lost to context-switching and multi-project meetings.
Critical bottleneck: <10% capacity per project. Over 60% consumed by cognitive thrashing and meeting fragmentation.

teamMitigation.description: When multiple members are assigned, bottleneck member drives primary schedule delay with team mitigation factor.
